text:
maya: Heads-up — deploy-bot queued a config-only patch for tonight's quiet window (23:00-01:00 UTC). Changes are limits/timeouts/routing + batching params only. Deploy ID cfg-2026-04-15-7. Any objections before we dry-run?

deploy-bot: DRY RUN initiated for cfg-2026-04-15-7. Affected routes: /v1/generate (all tiers). Preview diff: 
```
- tenant_rate_floor: 10
+ tenant_rate_floor: 8
- tenant_burst_limit: 200
+ tenant_burst_limit: 150
- kvcache_ttl_ms: 30000
+ kvcache_ttl_ms: 20000
- batch_window_ms: 10
+ batch_window_ms: 8
```
Will not change model versions.

noah: quick sanity check — lowering floor and burst will shave cost but might spike tail lat for multi-tenant bursts. Do we have a backpressure fallback?

maya: good call. Plan: smart routing fallback -> if latency > 95p threshold for 2m, route 5% traffic to legacy capacity and auto-pin config rollback. Observability hooks added.

linh: added the smoke-monitor check: latency-95p, error-rate, and kvcache-hit-rate. If any 2 of 3 trip within 3m, deploy-bot will unpin and trigger rollback fastpath.

samir: rollback fastpath looks like: `deploy-bot rollback cfg-2026-04-15-7 --reason fastpath` + `deploy-bot pin cfg-previous-2026-04-02`. Recommend we include a manual abort window at 23:10 in case we need to stop before auto actions.

maya: noted. I'll add abort window. Also: release notes stub for product: 
- Config-only: tuned tenant rate floor and burst to reduce burst cost; kv-cache TTL reduced to lower memory pressure; batching window tightened for throughput stability.

ops-bot: Reminder — change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Observability runbooks: #slo-alerts -> paging enabled for oncall after 3m. Canary traffic will be 2% for first 4 minutes then ramp to 25% in 6m, then 100% if green.

noah: ACK. I'll be on standby for first 20 mins. If anything odd, i'll post a rollback request in thread.

maya: thanks — executing dry-run now, will post quick logs and the deploy link. If no objections by 22:45 UTC we proceed to scheduled window. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: DRY RUN logs: all checks passed locally. Link: https://deploy.internal/runs/cfg-2026-04-15-7 (dry-run).

maya: final: please add a one-line to release-notes doc and mark the config as "config-only" in the changelog so that downstream teams can filter.

samir: added changelog entry and flagged for CS.

maya: OK closing — moving to scheduled. Will ping again at start of window.
